title.zh: 卷十 本紀第十 昭宗 哀帝
title.en: Volume 10 Annals 10: Emperor Zhao, Emperor Ai
title.raw: 卷十 本紀第十 昭宗 哀帝 Volume 10 Annals 10: Emperor Zhao, Emperor Ai

sentences.zh: 昭宗聖穆景文孝皇帝諱曄，懿宗第七子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhaozong, Emperor Zhaozong the Sagely Solemn and Civil Filial, taboo name Ye, was the seventh son of Yizong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhaozong, posthumously honored as the Sagely Solemn and Civil Filial, bore the taboo name Ye and was the seventh son of Yizong.

sentences.zh: 母曰恭憲皇太后王氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Gongxian of the Wang clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Gongxian, née Wang.

sentences.zh: 始封壽王。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Shou.
translations.idiomatic: He was first made Prince of Shou.

sentences.zh: 乾符三年，領幽州盧龍軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianfu he held the post of Youzhou Lulong army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qianfu he served as Youzhou Lulong military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 僖宗遇亂再出奔，壽王握兵侍左右，尤見倚信。

translations.literal: When Xizong encountered disorder and twice fled, the Prince of Shou held troops and attended at his side, and was especially relied upon and trusted.
translations.idiomatic: When Xizong fled the capital twice amid turmoil, the Prince of Shou commanded troops at his side and won exceptional trust.

sentences.zh: 文德元年

translations.literal: The first year of Wende.
translations.idiomatic: Wende, year 1.

sentences.zh: 文德元年三月，僖宗疾大漸，群臣以吉王長，且欲立之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Wende Xizong's illness became grave; the ministers because Prince of Ji was eldest wished to establish him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Wende, as Xizong's illness grew critical, the ministers favored installing the eldest Prince of Ji.

sentences.zh: 觀軍容使楊復恭率兵迎壽王，立為皇太弟，改名敏。

translations.literal: Army-observation commissioner Yang Fugong led troops to welcome the Prince of Shou, established him as imperial younger brother, and changed his name to Min.
translations.idiomatic: Army-observation commissioner Yang Fugong brought troops to welcome the Prince of Shou, made him imperial younger brother, and renamed him Min.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，即皇帝位於柩前。

translations.literal: On the day yisi he assumed the imperial throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰，孫儒陷揚州，自稱淮南節度使，楊行密奔於廬州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day wuchen Sun Ru captured Yangzhou, styled himself Huainan military commissioner, and Yang Xingmi fled to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on wuchen Sun Ru took Yangzhou, declared himself Huainan military commissioner, and Yang Xingmi fled to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，追尊母為皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu his mother was posthumously honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu his mother was posthumously honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 韋昭度為中書令，孔緯為司空。

translations.literal: Wei Zhaodu was made Secretariat Director; Kong Wei was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhaodu became Secretariat Director and Kong Wei Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，張全義陷孟州，李罕之奔於河東。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Zhang Quanyi captured Mengzhou; Li Hanzhi fled to Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhang Quanyi took Mengzhou and Li Hanzhi fled to Hedong.

sentences.zh: 成汭陷江陵，自稱留後。

translations.literal: Cheng Run captured Jiangling and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Run seized Jiangling and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，朱全忠及秦宗權戰于蔡州，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Zhu Quanzhong and Qin Zongquan fought at Caizhou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhu Quanzhong fought Qin Zongquan at Caizhou and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，趙德諲以襄州降，以德諲為忠義軍節度使、蔡州四面行營副都統。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day renyin Zhao Dekun surrendered Xiangzhou; Dekun was made Zhongyi army military commissioner and deputy overall commander of the four sides of Caizhou campaign troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on renyin Zhao Dekun surrendered Xiangzhou and was appointed Zhongyi military commissioner and deputy overall commander of the Caizhou campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月，閬州防禦使王建陷漢州，執刺史張頊，遂寇成都。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Langzhou defense commissioner Wang Jian captured Hanzhou, seized prefect Zhang Qi, and then raided Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wang Jian of Langzhou took Hanzhou, seized prefect Zhang Qi, and marched on Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 韋昭度罷為劍南西川節度副大使，兼兩川招撫制置使。

translations.literal: Wei Zhaodu was removed and made deputy ambassador of the Jiannan West Circuit military commission, concurrently pacification and disposition commissioner of the two circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhaodu was demoted to deputy Jiannan West Circuit commissioner and concurrent pacification commissioner for both circuits.

sentences.zh: 十月，陳敬瑄反。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Chen Jingxuan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Chen Jingxuan rebelled.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，葬惠聖恭定孝皇帝于靖陵。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the Sagely Respectful and Gracious Filial Emperor was buried at Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Sagely Respectful and Gracious Filial Emperor was interred at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，秦宗權陷許州，執忠武軍節度使王縕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day bingshen Qin Zongquan captured Xuzhou and seized Zhongwu army military commissioner Wang Yun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on bingshen Qin Zongquan took Xuzhou and seized Zhongwu military commissioner Wang Yun.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，奉國軍將申叢執秦宗權。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Fengguo army officer Shen Cong seized Qin Zongquan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Fengguo army officer Shen Cong captured Qin Zongquan.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，韋昭度為行營招討使，及永平軍節度使王建討陳敬瑄。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dinghai Wei Zhaodu was made campaign suppression commissioner, and Yongping army military commissioner Wang Jian was ordered to attack Chen Jingxuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dinghai Wei Zhaodu was made campaign suppression commissioner and Yongping military commissioner Wang Jian was sent against Chen Jingxuan.

sentences.zh: 山南西道節度使楊守厚陷夔州。

translations.literal: Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Yang Shouhou captured Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Yang Shouhou took Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 龍紀元年

translations.literal: The first year of Longji.
translations.idiomatic: Longji, year 1.

sentences.zh: 龍紀元年正月癸巳，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Longji on the day guisi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Longji on guisi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎劉崇望同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Liu Chongwang was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Liu Chongwang was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 壬子，宣武軍將郭璠殺奉國軍留後申叢，自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day renzi Xuanwu army officer Guo Fan killed Fengguo army acting commissioner Shen Cong and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Xuanwu army officer Guo Fan killed Fengguo acting commissioner Shen Cong and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，朱全忠俘秦宗權以獻。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day wuchen Zhu Quanzhong captured Qin Zongquan and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on wuchen Zhu Quanzhong captured Qin Zongquan and presented him to court.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宗權伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Zongquan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zongquan was executed.

sentences.zh: 三月，孔緯為司徒，杜讓能為司空。

translations.literal: In the third month Kong Wei was made Minister of Education; Du Rangneng was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Kong Wei became Minister of Education and Du Rangneng Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丙申，錢升陷蘇州，逐刺史徐約。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Qian Sheng captured Suzhou and expelled prefect Xu Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Qian Sheng took Suzhou and expelled prefect Xu Yue.

sentences.zh: 六月，李克用寇邢州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Li Keyong raided Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Li Keyong raided Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 昭義軍節度使孟方立卒，其弟遷自稱留後。

translations.literal: Zhaoyi army military commissioner Meng Fangli died; his younger brother Qian styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyi military commissioner Meng Fangli died and his younger brother Qian declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 楊行密陷宣州，宣歙觀察使趙鍠死之。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi captured Xuanzhou; Xuanshe observation commissioner Zhao Huang died.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi took Xuanzhou and Xuanshe observation commissioner Zhao Huang was killed.

sentences.zh: 廬州刺史蔡儔叛附于孫儒。

translations.literal: Luzhou prefect Cai Chou rebelled and submitted to Sun Ru.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou prefect Cai Chou rebelled and submitted to Sun Ru.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，孟遷叛附于李克用。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jiaxu Meng Qian rebelled and submitted to Li Keyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jiaxu Meng Qian rebelled and submitted to Li Keyong.

sentences.zh: 十月，平盧軍節度使王敬武卒，其子師範自稱留後，陷棣州，刺史張蟾死之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Pinglu army military commissioner Wang Jingwu died; his son Shifan styled himself acting commissioner, captured Dizhou, and prefect Zhang Chan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Pinglu military commissioner Wang Jingwu died; his son Shifan declared himself acting commissioner, took Dizhou, and prefect Zhang Chan was killed.

sentences.zh: 宣歙觀察使楊行密陷常州，刺史杜陵死之。

translations.literal: Xuanshe observation commissioner Yang Xingmi captured Changzhou; prefect Du Ling died.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanshe observation commissioner Yang Xingmi took Changzhou and prefect Du Ling was killed.

sentences.zh: 錢升陷潤州。

translations.literal: Qian Sheng captured Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Sheng took Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day dingwei tribute was offered at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on dingwei the emperor offered tribute at the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，朝享於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day wushen he attended sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he performed rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己酉，有事於南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou the southern suburban rites were performed and a general amnesty proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the southern suburban rites were held and a general amnesty proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，孫儒陷常、潤二州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Sun Ru captured Chang and Run prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Sun Ru took Chang and Run prefectures.

sentences.zh: 戊午，孫緯為太保，杜讓能為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Sun Wei was made Grand Mentor; Du Rangneng was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Sun Wei became Grand Mentor and Du Rangneng Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 壬申，眉州刺史山行章叛附于王建。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Meizhou prefect Shan Xingzhang rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Meizhou prefect Shan Xingzhang rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.

sentences.zh: 大順元年

translations.literal: The first year of Dashun.
translations.idiomatic: Dashun, year 1.

sentences.zh: 大順元年正月戊子，群臣上尊號曰聖文睿德光武弘孝皇帝，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Dashun on the day wuzi the ministers offered the honorific title Sagely Civil, Sagely Virtuous, Bright Martial, and Grandly Filial Emperor; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Dashun on wuzi the ministers offered the honorific Sagely Civil, Sagely Virtuous, Bright Martial, and Grandly Filial Emperor; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，簡州將杜有遷執其刺史員虔嵩，叛附于王建。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Jianzhou officer Du Youqian seized his prefect Yuan Qiansong and rebelled, submitting to Wang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Jianzhou officer Du Youqian seized prefect Yuan Qiansong and rebelled, submitting to Wang Jian.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，資州將侯元綽執其刺史楊戡，叛附於建。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiwei Zizhou officer Hou Yuanchuo seized his prefect Yang Kan and rebelled, submitting to Jian.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiwei Zizhou officer Hou Yuanchuo seized prefect Yang Kan and rebelled, submitting to Jian.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，昭義軍節度使李克修卒，其弟克恭自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day wushen Zhaoyi army military commissioner Li Kexiu died; his younger brother Kejing styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on wushen Zhaoyi military commissioner Li Kexiu died and his younger brother Kejing declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月丙辰，宿州將張筠逐其刺史張紹光。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day bingchen Suzhou officer Zhang Yun expelled his prefect Zhang Shaoguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingchen Suzhou officer Zhang Yun expelled prefect Zhang Shaoguang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，嘉州刺史朱實叛附于王建。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Jiazhou prefect Zhu Shi rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Jiazhou prefect Zhu Shi rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.

sentences.zh: 丙子，戎州將文武堅執其刺史謝承恩，叛附於建。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Rongzhou officer Wen Wujian seized his prefect Xie Chengen and rebelled, submitting to Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Rongzhou officer Wen Wujian seized prefect Xie Chengen and rebelled, submitting to Jian.

sentences.zh: 五月，張浚為河東行營都招討宣慰使，京兆尹孫揆副之；

translations.literal: In the fifth month Zhang Jun was made Hedong campaign overall suppression and consolation commissioner, with Jingzhao governor Sun Kui as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Zhang Jun was made Hedong campaign overall suppression and consolation commissioner, with Jingzhao governor Sun Kui as deputy;

sentences.zh: 幽州盧龍軍節度使李匡威為北面招討使，雲州防禦使赫連鐸副之；

translations.literal: Youzhou Lulong army military commissioner Li Kuangwei was made northern suppression commissioner, with Yunzhou defense commissioner Helian Duo as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou Lulong military commissioner Li Kuangwei was made northern suppression commissioner, with Yunzhou defense commissioner Helian Duo as deputy;

sentences.zh: 朱全忠為南面招討使，王熔為東面招討使，以討李克用。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong was made southern suppression commissioner and Wang Rong eastern suppression commissioner, to attack Li Keyong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong was made southern suppression commissioner and Wang Rong eastern suppression commissioner to attack Li Keyong.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，昭義軍將安居受殺其節度使李克恭，叛附于朱全忠。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Zhaoyi army officer An Jushou killed his military commissioner Li Kejing and rebelled, submitting to Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhaoyi army officer An Jushou killed military commissioner Li Kejing and rebelled, submitting to Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，劍南東川節度使顧彥朗卒，其弟彥暉自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Jiannan East Circuit military commissioner Gu Yanlang died; his younger brother Yanhui styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Jiannan East Circuit military commissioner Gu Yanlang died and his younger brother Yanhui declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，雅州將謝從本殺其刺史張承簡，叛附于王建。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day xinyou Yazhou officer Xie Congben killed his prefect Zhang Chengjian and rebelled, submitting to Wang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on xinyou Yazhou officer Xie Congben killed prefect Zhang Chengjian and rebelled, submitting to Wang Jian.

sentences.zh: 辛未，朱全忠為河東東面行營招討使。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Zhu Quanzhong was made Hedong eastern campaign suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhu Quanzhong was made Hedong eastern campaign suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，河東將安知建以邢、洺、滋三州叛附于全忠。

translations.literal: That month Hedong officer An Zhijian with Xing, Ming, and Ci prefectures rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hedong officer An Zhijian surrendered Xing, Ming, and Ci prefectures to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 七月，楊行密陷潤州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Yang Xingmi captured Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Yang Xingmi took Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，李克用執昭義軍節度使孫揆。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Li Keyong seized Zhaoyi army military commissioner Sun Kui.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Keyong seized Zhaoyi military commissioner Sun Kui.

sentences.zh: 八月，錢升殺蘇州刺史杜孺休。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Qian Sheng killed Suzhou prefect Du Ruxiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Qian Sheng killed Suzhou prefect Du Ruxiu.

sentences.zh: 楊行密陷蘇州。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi captured Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi took Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 海南節度使孫儒陷潤州。

translations.literal: Hainan military commissioner Sun Ru captured Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hainan military commissioner Sun Ru took Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，朱全忠為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Zhu Quanzhong was made Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhu Quanzhong was made Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 九月，李克用陷潞州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Li Keyong captured Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Li Keyong took Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 楊行密陷潤、常二州。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi captured Run and Chang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi took Run and Chang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 閏月，孫儒陷常州。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month Sun Ru captured Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Sun Ru took Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，邛州將任可知殺其刺史毛湘。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Qiongzhou officer Ren Kezhi killed his prefect Mao Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Qiongzhou officer Ren Kezhi killed prefect Mao Xiang.

sentences.zh: 十月癸未，蜀州刺史李行周叛附于王建。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day guiwei Shuzhou prefect Li Xingzhou rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on guiwei Shuzhou prefect Li Xingzhou rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.

sentences.zh: 李克用陷邢、洺、滋三州。

translations.literal: Li Keyong captured Xing, Ming, and Ci prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong took Xing, Ming, and Ci prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，李匡威陷蔚州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day dingmao Li Kuangwei captured Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on dingmao Li Kuangwei took Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，張浚及李克用戰于陰地，敗績。

translations.literal: That month Zhang Jun and Li Keyong fought at Yindi and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Jun fought Li Keyong at Yindi and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 孫儒陷蘇州。

translations.literal: Sun Ru captured Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ru took Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，李克用陷晉州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Li Keyong captured Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Li Keyong took Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年正月庚申，孔緯、張浚罷。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year on the day gengshen Kong Wei and Zhang Jun were removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year on gengshen Kong Wei and Zhang Jun were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎崔昭緯，御史中丞徐彥若為戶部侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Cui Zhaowei, and Censor-in-Chief Xu Yanruo as Minister of Revenue: Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of War Cui Zhaowei and Censor-in-Chief Xu Yanruo as Minister of Revenue were appointed Associate Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甘露鎮使陳可言陷常州。

translations.literal: Ganlu garrison commissioner Chen Keyan captured Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ganlu garrison commissioner Chen Keyan took Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 錢升陷蘇州。

translations.literal: Qian Sheng captured Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Sheng took Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，赦陳敬瑄。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day yisi Chen Jingxuan was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yisi Chen Jingxuan was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔王建罷兵，不受命。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei an edict ordered Wang Jian to cease troops; he did not accept the command.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an edict ordered Wang Jian to stand down; he refused.

sentences.zh: 是春，淮南大饑。

translations.literal: That spring Huainan suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Huainan suffered severe famine.

sentences.zh: 四月庚辰，有彗星入於太微。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day gengchen a comet entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on gengchen a comet entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大赦，避正殿，減膳，徹樂。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen a general amnesty was proclaimed; the emperor avoided the main hall, reduced meals, and suspended music.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen a general amnesty was proclaimed; the emperor withdrew from the main hall, reduced meals, and suspended music.

sentences.zh: 賜兩軍金帛，贖所略男女還其家。

translations.literal: Gold and silk were bestowed on the two armies; captured men and women were ransomed and returned to their families.
translations.idiomatic: Gold and silk were given to the two armies; seized men and women were ransomed and sent home.

sentences.zh: 民年八十以上及疾不能自存者，長吏存恤。

translations.literal: For commoners eighty years of age and above and those ill and unable to support themselves, local officials were to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials were to care for commoners eighty or older and those too ill to support themselves.

sentences.zh: 訪武德功臣子孫。

translations.literal: Descendants of Wude-era meritorious officials were sought.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of Wude-era meritorious officials were sought out.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，王建寇成都。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Wang Jian raided Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Wang Jian attacked Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 五月，孫儒陷和、滁二州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Sun Ru captured He and Chu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Sun Ru took He and Chu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 六月，楊行密陷和、滁二州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Yang Xingmi captured He and Chu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yang Xingmi took He and Chu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丙午，封子祐為德王。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu his son You was enfeoffed as Prince of De.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu his son You was made Prince of De.

sentences.zh: 七月，李克用陷雲州，防禦使赫連鐸奔於退渾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Li Keyong captured Yunzhou; defense commissioner Helian Duo fled to the Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Li Keyong took Yunzhou and defense commissioner Helian Duo fled to the Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 孫儒焚揚州以逃。

translations.literal: Sun Ru burned Yangzhou and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ru burned Yangzhou and fled.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，王建陷成都，執劍南西川節度使陳敬瑄，自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day gengzi Wang Jian captured Chengdu, seized Jiannan West Circuit military commissioner Chen Jingxuan, and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengzi Wang Jian took Chengdu, seized Jiannan West Circuit military commissioner Chen Jingxuan, and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十月壬午，朱全忠陷宿州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day renwu Zhu Quanzhong captured Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on renwu Zhu Quanzhong took Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，曹州將郭銖殺其刺史郭詞，叛附于全忠。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jiwei Caozhou officer Guo Zhu killed his prefect Guo Ci and rebelled, submitting to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiwei Caozhou officer Guo Zhu killed prefect Guo Ci and rebelled, submitting to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 辛未，全忠陷壽州。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Quanzhong captured Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Quanzhong took Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 景福元年

translations.literal: The first year of Jingfu.
translations.idiomatic: Jingfu, year 1.

sentences.zh: 景福元年正月己未，朱全忠陷孟州，逐河陽節度使趙克裕。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jingfu on the day jiwei Zhu Quanzhong captured Mengzhou and expelled Heyang military commissioner Zhao Keyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Jingfu on jiwei Zhu Quanzhong took Mengzhou and expelled Heyang military commissioner Zhao Keyu.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 二月，劉崇望罷。

translations.literal: In the second month Liu Chongwang was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Liu Chongwang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 錢升陷蘇州。

translations.literal: Qian Sheng captured Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Sheng took Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，朱全忠寇鄆州，天平軍節度使朱宣敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Zhu Quanzhong raided Yanzhou; Tianping army military commissioner Zhu Xuan defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhu Quanzhong raided Yanzhou and Tianping military commissioner Zhu Xuan repelled him.

sentences.zh: 三月，戶部尚書鄭延昌為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the third month Minister of Revenue Zheng Yanchang was made Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Minister of Revenue Zheng Yanchang was appointed Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，楊行密陷楚州，執刺史劉瓚；

translations.literal: On the day yisi Yang Xingmi captured Chuzhou and seized prefect Liu Zan;
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Yang Xingmi took Chuzhou and seized prefect Liu Zan;

sentences.zh: 又陷常州，刺史陳可言死之。

translations.literal: He also captured Changzhou; prefect Chen Keyan died.
translations.idiomatic: He also took Changzhou and prefect Chen Keyan was killed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，武定軍節度使楊守忠、龍劍節度使楊守貞會楊守厚兵寇梓州。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Wuding military commissioner Yang Shouzhong and Longjian military commissioner Yang Shouzhen joined Yang Shouhou's troops to raid Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wuding military commissioner Yang Shouzhong and Longjian military commissioner Yang Shouzhen joined Yang Shouhou's forces to attack Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，福建觀察使陳岩卒，護閩都將範暉自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Fujian observation commissioner Chen Yan died; Protect Fujian metropolitan general Fan Hui styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Fujian observation commissioner Chen Yan died and Protect Fujian metropolitan general Fan Hui declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，泉州刺史王潮寇福州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Quanzhou prefect Wang Chao raided Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Quanzhou prefect Wang Chao attacked Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 四月辛巳，杜讓能為太尉。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day xinsi Du Rangneng was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on xinsi Du Rangneng became Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，楊行密陷揚州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day wuyin Yang Xingmi captured Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on wuyin Yang Xingmi took Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，鳳翔隴右節度使李茂貞陷鳳州，感義軍節度使滿存奔於興元，遂陷興、洋二州。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Fengxiang Longyou military commissioner Li Maozhen captured Fengzhou; Ganyi army military commissioner Man Cun fled to Xingyuan, and then Xing and Yang prefectures were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Fengxiang Longyou military commissioner Li Maozhen took Fengzhou; Ganyi military commissioner Man Cun fled to Xingyuan, and Maozhen then seized Xing and Yang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，寇興元，楊守亮、滿存奔於閬州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day renshen he raided Xingyuan; Yang Shouliang and Man Cun fled to Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renshen he attacked Xingyuan and Yang Shouliang and Man Cun fled to Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，降京畿、關輔囚罪，免淮南、浙西、宣州逋負。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu capital-region and Guanfu convicts' sentences were reduced; Huainan, Zhexi, and Xuanzhou arrears were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu sentences for capital-region and Guanfu convicts were reduced and arrears in Huainan, Zhexi, and Xuanzhou were remitted.

sentences.zh: 十月，蔡儔以廬州叛附于朱全忠，河東將李存孝以邢州叛附于全忠。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Cai Chou with Luzhou rebelled and submitted to Zhu Quanzhong; Hedong officer Li Cunxiao with Xingzhou rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Cai Chou surrendered Luzhou to Zhu Quanzhong and Hedong officer Li Cunxiao surrendered Xingzhou to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 十一月，有星孛于鬥、牛。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month a broom star appeared in the Dipper and Ox constellations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month a broom star appeared in the Dipper and Ox.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，武寧軍將張燧、張諫以濠、泗二州叛附于朱全忠。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Wuning army officers Zhang Sui and Zhang Jian with Hao and Si prefectures rebelled and submitted to Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wuning army officers Zhang Sui and Zhang Jian surrendered Hao and Si prefectures to Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，朱友裕陷濮州，執刺史邵儒。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Zhu Youyu captured Puzhou and seized prefect Shao Ru.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Zhu Youyu took Puzhou and seized prefect Shao Ru.

sentences.zh: 孫儒將王壇陷婺州，刺史蔣瑰奔於越州。

translations.literal: Sun Ru's officer Wang Tan captured Wuzhou; prefect Jiang Gui fled to Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ru's officer Wang Tan took Wuzhou and prefect Jiang Gui fled to Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，明州刺史鐘文季卒，其將黃晟自稱刺史。

translations.literal: That year Mingzhou prefect Zhong Wenji died; his officer Huang Sheng styled himself prefect.
translations.idiomatic: That year Mingzhou prefect Zhong Wenji died and his officer Huang Sheng declared himself prefect.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，徐彥若罷為鳳翔隴右節度使，李茂貞為山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Xu Yanruo was removed and made Fengxiang Longyou military commissioner; Li Maozhen was made Shannan West Circuit military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Xu Yanruo was reassigned as Fengxiang Longyou military commissioner and Li Maozhen as Shannan West Circuit military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 茂貞不受命。

translations.literal: Maozhen did not accept the command.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen refused the appointment.

sentences.zh: 二月，楊行密陷常州。

translations.literal: In the second month Yang Xingmi captured Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Yang Xingmi took Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，幽州盧龍軍兵馬留後李匡籌逐其兄匡威，自稱節度留後。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day xinyou Youzhou Lulong army troop-and-horse acting commissioner Li Kuangchou expelled his elder brother Kuangwei and styled himself acting military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinyou Youzhou Lulong troop-and-horse acting commissioner Li Kuangchou ousted his elder brother Kuangwei and declared himself acting military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月乙亥，王建殺陳敬瑄及劍南西川監軍田令孜。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day yihai Wang Jian killed Chen Jingxuan and Jiannan West Circuit army supervisor Tian Lingzi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on yihai Wang Jian killed Chen Jingxuan and Jiannan West Circuit army supervisor Tian Lingzi.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，有彗星入於太微。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou a comet entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou a comet entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，王熔殺李匡威。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai Wang Rong killed Li Kuangwei.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Wang Rong killed Li Kuangwei.

sentences.zh: 戊子，朱全忠陷徐州，武寧軍節度使時溥死之。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Zhu Quanzhong captured Xuzhou; Wuning army military commissioner Shi Pu died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhu Quanzhong took Xuzhou and Wuning military commissioner Shi Pu was killed.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，王潮陷福州，範暉死之，潮自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day gengzi Wang Chao captured Fuzhou; Fan Hui died; Chao styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengzi Wang Chao took Fuzhou, Fan Hui was killed, and Chao declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月，楊行密陷廬州，蔡儔死之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Yang Xingmi captured Luzhou; Cai Chou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Yang Xingmi took Luzhou and Cai Chou was killed.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，嗣覃王嗣周為京西路招討使，神策大將軍李鐵副之，以討李茂貞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day bingshen Heir Apparent Prince of Tan Sizhou was made Jingxi Circuit suppression commissioner, with Divine Strategy great general Li Tie as deputy, to attack Li Maozhen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingshen Heir Apparent Prince of Tan Sizhou was made Jingxi Circuit suppression commissioner with Divine Strategy great general Li Tie as deputy to attack Li Maozhen.

sentences.zh: 庚子，升州刺史張雄卒，其將馮弘鐸自稱刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Shengzhou prefect Zhang Xiong died; his officer Feng Hongduo styled himself prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Shengzhou prefect Zhang Xiong died and his officer Feng Hongduo declared himself prefect.

sentences.zh: 是月，楊行密陷歙州。

translations.literal: That month Yang Xingmi captured Shezhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yang Xingmi took Shezhou.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，嗣覃王嗣周及李茂貞戰于興平，敗績。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day renwu Heir Apparent Prince of Tan Sizhou and Li Maozhen fought at Xingping and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on renwu Heir Apparent Prince of Tan Sizhou fought Li Maozhen at Xingping and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 甲申，茂貞犯京師。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Maozhen attacked the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Maozhen attacked the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，茂貞殺觀軍容使西門重遂、內樞密使李周訁童、段詡。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou Maozhen killed army-observation commissioner Ximen Chongsui, Inner Palace Commissioner Li Zhouyi, and Duan Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Maozhen killed army-observation commissioner Ximen Chongsui, Inner Palace Commissioner Li Zhouyi, and Duan Xu.

sentences.zh: 貶杜讓能為梧州刺史。

translations.literal: Du Rangneng was demoted to Wuzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Du Rangneng was demoted to prefect of Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，東都留守、檢校司徒韋昭度為司徒，御史中丞崔胤為戶部侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day renchen Eastern Capital regent and Acting Minister of Education Wei Zhaodu was made Minister of Education; Censor-in-Chief Cui Yin as Minister of Revenue: Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Eastern Capital regent and Acting Minister of Education Wei Zhaodu became Minister of Education; Censor-in-Chief Cui Yin as Minister of Revenue was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 是月，升州刺史馮弘鐸叛附于楊行密。

translations.literal: That month Shengzhou prefect Feng Hongduo rebelled and submitted to Yang Xingmi.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shengzhou prefect Feng Hongduo rebelled and submitted to Yang Xingmi.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，殺杜讓能及戶部侍郎杜弘徽。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day yiwei Du Rangneng and Minister of Revenue Du Honghui were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on yiwei Du Rangneng and Minister of Revenue Du Honghui were executed.

sentences.zh: 楊行密陷舒州。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi captured Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi took Shuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，韋昭度為太傅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Wei Zhaodu was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Wei Zhaodu became Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 邵州刺史鄧處訥陷潭州，欽化軍節度使周岳死之，處訥自稱留後。

translations.literal: Shaozhou prefect Deng Chuna captured Tanzhou; Qinhua army military commissioner Zhou Yue died; Chuna styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhou prefect Deng Chuna took Tanzhou, Qinhua military commissioner Zhou Yue was killed, and Chuna declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是歲，建州刺史徐歸范、汀州刺史鐘全慕叛附于王潮。

translations.literal: That year Jianzhou prefect Xu Guifan and Tingzhou prefect Zhong Quanmu rebelled and submitted to Wang Chao.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jianzhou prefect Xu Guifan and Tingzhou prefect Zhong Quanmu rebelled and submitted to Wang Chao.

sentences.zh: 乾寧元年

translations.literal: The first year of Qianning.
translations.idiomatic: Qianning, year 1.

sentences.zh: 乾寧元年正月，有星孛於鶉首。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Qianning a broom star appeared in the Quail's Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Qianning a broom star appeared in the Quail's Head.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day yichou a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 李茂貞以兵來朝。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen came to court with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Li Maozhen came to court at the head of his army.

sentences.zh: 二月，右散騎常侍鄭綮為禮部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the second month Right Regular Attendant Zheng Zhen was made Minister of Rites and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Right Regular Attendant Zheng Zhen was appointed Minister of Rites and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 彰義軍節度使張鈞卒，其兄钅番自稱留後。

translations.literal: Zhangyi army military commissioner Zhang Jun died; his elder brother Fan styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangyi military commissioner Zhang Jun died and his elder brother Fan declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，李克用寇邢州，執李存孝殺之。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiashen Li Keyong raided Xingzhou, seized Li Cunxiao, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiashen Li Keyong raided Xingzhou, seized Li Cunxiao, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，王建陷彭州，威戎軍節度使楊晟死之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day bingzi Wang Jian captured Pengzhou; Weirong army military commissioner Yang Sheng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingzi Wang Jian took Pengzhou and Weirong military commissioner Yang Sheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，鄭延昌罷。

translations.literal: That month Zheng Yanchang was removed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zheng Yanchang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 孫儒將劉建鋒、馬殷陷潭州，武安軍節度使鄧處訥死之，建鋒自稱留後。

translations.literal: Sun Ru's officers Liu Jianfeng and Ma Yin captured Tanzhou; Wu'an army military commissioner Deng Chuna died; Jianfeng styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Ru's officers Liu Jianfeng and Ma Yin took Tanzhou, Wu'an military commissioner Deng Chuna was killed, and Jianfeng declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 武岡指揮使蔣勳陷邵州。

translations.literal: Wugang commandery commissioner Jiang Xun captured Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wugang commandery commissioner Jiang Xun took Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，大同軍防禦使赫連鐸及李克用戰於雲州，死之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Datong army defense commissioner Helian Duo and Li Keyong fought at Yunzhou; Duo died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Datong defense commissioner Helian Duo fought Li Keyong at Yunzhou and was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，翰林學士承旨、禮部尚書李磎同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of Rites Li Xi was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Hanlin Academician Expositor and Minister of Rites Li Xi was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 庚申，磎罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen Xi was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Xi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫徐彥若為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Xu Yanruo was made Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Xu Yanruo was appointed Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月，以雨霖避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: In the seventh month because of prolonged rain the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month prolonged rains led the emperor to withdraw from the main hall and reduce meals.

sentences.zh: 鄭綮罷。

translations.literal: Zheng Zhen was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zhen was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 李茂貞陷閬州。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen captured Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Maozhen took Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，楊守亮伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Yang Shouliang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yang Shouliang was executed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，減京畿、興元、洋金商州賦役。

translations.literal: On the day guisi levies in the capital region, Xingyuan, and Yang, Jin, and Shang prefectures were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi levies in the capital region, Xingyuan, and Yang, Jin, and Shang prefectures were reduced.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，李克用陷潞州，昭義軍節度使康君立死之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengshen Li Keyong captured Luzhou; Zhaoyi army military commissioner Kang Junli died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengshen Li Keyong took Luzhou and Zhaoyi military commissioner Kang Junli was killed.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉，封子祤為棣王，禊虔王，禋沂王，禕遂王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingyou his sons Qi were enfeoffed as Prince of Di, Xi as Prince of Qian, Yin as Prince of Yi, and Yi as Prince of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on dingyou his sons Qi, Xi, Yin, and Yi were made Princes of Di, Qian, Yi, and Sui.

sentences.zh: 十一月，李克用陷武州。

sentences.zh: 楊行密為江南諸道行營都統。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi was made overall commander of the Jiangnan circuits campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi was made overall commander of the Jiangnan circuits campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，王建陷瀘州，刺史馬敬儒死之。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Wang Jian captured Luzhou; prefect Ma Jingru died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Wang Jian took Luzhou and prefect Ma Jingru was killed.

sentences.zh: 己未，立德王裕為皇太子，太赦，饗於行廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei Virtuous King Yu was established as heir apparent; a great amnesty was proclaimed; a feast was held at the traveling temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Virtuous King Yu was made heir apparent; a great amnesty was proclaimed and a feast held at the traveling temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，王建陷渝州。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Wang Jian captured Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Wang Jian took Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，孫偓、朱樸罷。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Sun Wo and Zhu Pu were removed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Sun Wo and Zhu Pu were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，朱全忠陷黃州，刺史矍璋死之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day renwu Zhu Quanzhong captured Huangzhou; prefect Qu Zhang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on renwu Zhu Quanzhong took Huangzhou and prefect Qu Zhang was killed.

sentences.zh: 六月，貶王建為南州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Wang Jian was demoted to Nanzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wang Jian was demoted to prefect of Nan.

sentences.zh: 以李茂貞為劍南西川節度使，嗣覃王嗣周為鳳翔隴右節度使，茂貞不受命，嗣周及茂貞戰於奉天，敗績。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen was made Jiannan West Circuit military commissioner and Heir Apparent Prince of Tan Sizhou Fengxiang Longyou military commissioner; Maozhen did not accept the command; Sizhou and Maozhen fought at Fengtian and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Li Maozhen was appointed Jiannan West Circuit military commissioner and Heir Apparent Prince of Tan Sizhou Fengxiang Longyou military commissioner; Maozhen refused; Sizhou fought Maozhen at Fengtian and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 八月，韓建殺通王滋、沂王禋、韶王、彭王、嗣韓王、嗣陳王、嗣覃王嗣周、嗣延王戒丕、嗣丹王允。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Han Jian killed Prince of Tong Zi, Prince of Yi Yin, Prince of Shao, Prince of Peng, Heir Apparent Prince of Han, Heir Apparent Prince of Chen, Heir Apparent Prince of Tan Sizhou, Heir Apparent Prince of Yan Jiepi, and Heir Apparent Prince of Dan Yun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Han Jian killed Prince of Tong Zi, Prince of Yi Yin, Prince of Shao, Prince of Peng, Heir Apparent Prince of Han, Heir Apparent Prince of Chen, Heir Apparent Prince of Tan Sizhou, Heir Apparent Prince of Yan Jiepi, and Heir Apparent Prince of Dan Yun.

sentences.zh: 九月，錢升陷湖州，忠國軍節度使李繼徽奔於淮南。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Qian Sheng captured Huzhou; Zhongguo military commissioner Li Jihui fled to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Qian Sheng took Huzhou and Zhongguo military commissioner Li Jihui fled to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 彰義軍節度使張璉為鳳翔西北行營招討使，靜難軍節度使李思諫為鳳翔四面行營副都統，以討李茂貞。

translations.literal: Zhangyi army military commissioner Zhang Lian was made Fengxiang northwest campaign suppression commissioner; Jingnan military commissioner Li Sijian was made Fengxiang four-sides campaign deputy overall commander, to attack Li Maozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangyi military commissioner Zhang Lian was made Fengxiang northwest campaign suppression commissioner and Jingnan military commissioner Li Sijian Fengxiang four-sides campaign deputy overall commander to attack Li Maozhen.

sentences.zh: 十月壬子，遂州刺史侯紹叛附于王建。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day renzi Suizhou prefect Hou Shao rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on renzi Suizhou prefect Hou Shao rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，合州刺史王仁威叛附於建。

translations.literal: On the day yimao Hezhou prefect Wang Renwei rebelled and submitted to Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Hezhou prefect Wang Renwei rebelled and submitted to Jian.

sentences.zh: 庚申，建陷梓州，劍南東川節度使顧彥暉死之。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen Jian captured Zizhou; Jiannan East Circuit military commissioner Gu Yanhui died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Jian took Zizhou and Jiannan East Circuit military commissioner Gu Yanhui was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，封子秘為景王，祚輝王，祺祁王。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi his sons Mi were enfeoffed as Prince of Jing, Zuo as Prince of Hui, and Qi as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi his sons Mi, Zuo, and Qi were made Princes of Jing, Hui, and Qi.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，楊行密及朱全忠戰於消口，敗之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day guiyou Yang Xingmi and Zhu Quanzhong fought at Xiaokou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on guiyou Yang Xingmi fought Zhu Quanzhong at Xiaokou and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丙子，錢升陷台州。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Qian Sheng captured Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Qian Sheng took Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，威武軍節度使王潮卒，其弟審知自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dingwei Weiwu army military commissioner Wang Chao died; his younger brother Shenzhi styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingwei Weiwu military commissioner Wang Chao died and his younger brother Shenzhi declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 光化元年

translations.literal: The first year of Guanghua.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghua, year 1.

sentences.zh: 光化元年正月，徐彥若為司徒。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Guanghua Xu Yanruo was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Guanghua Xu Yanruo became Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 二月，赦李茂貞。

translations.literal: In the second month Li Maozhen was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Li Maozhen was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 三月，幽州盧龍軍節度使劉仁恭之子守文陷滄州，義昌軍節度使盧彥威奔於汴州。

translations.literal: In the third month Youzhou Lulong army military commissioner Liu Rengong's son Shouwen captured Cangzhou; Yichang military commissioner Lu Yanwei fled to Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Youzhou Lulong military commissioner Liu Rengong's son Shouwen took Cangzhou and Yichang military commissioner Lu Yanwei fled to Bianzhou.

sentences.zh: 四月丙寅，立淑妃何氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day bingyin Virtuous Consort He was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingyin Virtuous Consort He was made empress.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，大赦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day jisi a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jisi a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，朱全忠陷洺州，刺史邢善益死之；

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Zhu Quanzhong captured Mingzhou; prefect Xing Shanyi died;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhu Quanzhong took Mingzhou and prefect Xing Shanyi was killed;

sentences.zh: 又陷邢州。

translations.literal: He also captured Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: he also took Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，陷磁州，刺史袁奉韜死之。

translations.literal: On the day renwu he captured Cizhou; prefect Yuan Fengtao died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he took Cizhou and prefect Yuan Fengtao was killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，馬殷陷邵、衡、永三州，刺史蔣勳、楊師遠、唐旻死之。

translations.literal: That month Ma Yin captured Shao, Heng, and Yong prefectures; prefects Jiang Xun, Yang Shiyuan, and Tang Min died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ma Yin took Shao, Heng, and Yong prefectures and prefects Jiang Xun, Yang Shiyuan, and Tang Min were killed.

sentences.zh: 七月丙申，朱全忠陷唐州，又陷隋州，執刺史趙匡璘。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day bingshen Zhu Quanzhong captured Tangzhou, also captured Suizhou, and seized prefect Zhao Kuanglin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on bingshen Zhu Quanzhong took Tangzhou and Suizhou and seized prefect Zhao Kuanglin.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，陷鄧州，執刺史國湘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day wuwu he captured Dengzhou and seized prefect Guo Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on wuwu he took Dengzhou and seized prefect Guo Xiang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，至自華州。

translations.literal: On the day renxu the emperor returned from Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the emperor returned from Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，有星隕於北方。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingzi a star fell in the north.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingzi a star fell in the north.

sentences.zh: 甲申，錢升陷蘇州。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Qian Sheng captured Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Qian Sheng took Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月，魏博節度使羅弘信卒，其子紹威自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Weibo military commissioner Luo Hongxin died; his son Shaowei styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Weibo military commissioner Luo Hongxin died and his son Shaowei declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，朱全忠陷安州，刺史武瑜死之。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Zhu Quanzhong captured Anzhou; prefect Wu Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhu Quanzhong took Anzhou and prefect Wu Yu was killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月，衢州刺史陳岌叛附于楊行密。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Quzhou prefect Chen Ji rebelled and submitted to Yang Xingmi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Quzhou prefect Chen Ji rebelled and submitted to Yang Xingmi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，封子禛為雅王，祥瓊王。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin his sons Zhen were enfeoffed as Prince of Ya and Xiang as Prince of Qiong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin his sons Zhen and Xiang were made Princes of Ya and Qiong.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，李罕之陷潞州，自稱節度留後。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day guiwei Li Hanzhi captured Luzhou and styled himself acting military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on guiwei Li Hanzhi took Luzhou and declared himself acting military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 李克用陷澤州。

translations.literal: Li Keyong captured Zezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong took Zezhou.

sentences.zh: 二年正月乙未，給復綿、劍二州二年。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year on the day yiwei Mian and Jian prefectures were granted two years' tax relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year on yiwei Mian and Jian prefectures were granted two years' tax relief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，崔胤罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Cui Yin was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Cui Yin was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書陸扆同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Minister of War Lu Yi was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Lu Yi was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 是月，李罕之陷沁州。

translations.literal: That month Li Hanzhi captured Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Hanzhi took Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 劉仁恭陷貝州。

translations.literal: Liu Rengong captured Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rengong took Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，朱全忠陷蔡州，奉國軍節度使崔洪奔於淮南。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiazi Zhu Quanzhong captured Caizhou; Fengguo military commissioner Cui Hong fled to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiazi Zhu Quanzhong took Caizhou and Fengguo military commissioner Cui Hong fled to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，全忠陷澤州。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day dingsi Quanzhong captured Zezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on dingsi Quanzhong took Zezhou.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，保義軍亂，殺其節度使王珙，其將李璠叛附于全忠。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day dingchou Baoyi army mutinied, killed its military commissioner Wang Gong, and his officer Li Fan rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on dingchou Baoyi army mutinied, killed military commissioner Wang Gong, and his officer Li Fan rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，海州戍將陳漢賓以其州叛附于楊行密。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day renchen Haizhou garrison officer Chen Hanbin with his prefecture rebelled and submitted to Yang Xingmi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on renchen Haizhou garrison officer Chen Hanbin surrendered his prefecture to Yang Xingmi.

sentences.zh: 馬殷陷道州，刺史蔡結死之。

translations.literal: Ma Yin captured Daozhou; prefect Cai Jie died.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yin took Daozhou and prefect Cai Jie was killed.

sentences.zh: 八月，李克用陷澤、潞、懷三州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Li Keyong captured Ze, Lu, and Huai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Li Keyong took Ze, Lu, and Huai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十一月，徐彥若為太保，王摶為司空。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Xu Yanruo was made Grand Mentor; Wang Bo was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Xu Yanruo became Grand Mentor and Wang Bo Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 馬殷陷郴、連二州，刺史陳彥謙、魯景仁死之。

translations.literal: Ma Yin captured Chen and Lian prefectures; prefects Chen Yanqian and Lu Jingren died.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yin took Chen and Lian prefectures and prefects Chen Yanqian and Lu Jingren were killed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，保義軍將朱簡殺其節度使李璠，叛附于朱全忠。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Baoyi army officer Zhu Jian killed its military commissioner Li Fan and rebelled, submitting to Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Baoyi army officer Zhu Jian killed military commissioner Li Fan and rebelled, submitting to Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 三年四月辛未，皇后及皇太子享于太廟。

translations.literal: In the third year in the fourth month on the day xinwei the empress and heir apparent offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year in the fourth month on xinwei the empress and heir apparent offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，清海軍節度使崔胤為尚書左僕射，兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day dingmao Qinghai army military commissioner Cui Yin was made Left Vice Minister of Works, concurrently Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on dingmao Qinghai military commissioner Cui Yin was appointed Left Vice Minister of Works and concurrently Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 王摶罷。

translations.literal: Wang Bo was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，殺之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he was executed.

sentences.zh: 七月，浙江溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Zhejiang overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Zhejiang flooded.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，李克用陷洺州，執刺史朱紹宗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day gengchen Li Keyong captured Mingzhou and seized prefect Zhu Shaozong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengchen Li Keyong took Mingzhou and seized prefect Zhu Shaozong.

sentences.zh: 九月，朱全忠陷洺州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Zhu Quanzhong captured Mingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zhu Quanzhong took Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 錢升陷婺州，刺史王壇奔于宣州。

translations.literal: Qian Sheng captured Wuzhou; prefect Wang Tan fled to Xuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Sheng took Wuzhou and prefect Wang Tan fled to Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 衢州刺史陳岌叛附于錢升。

translations.literal: Quzhou prefect Chen Ji rebelled and submitted to Qian Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Quzhou prefect Chen Ji rebelled and submitted to Qian Sheng.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，徐彥若罷。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Xu Yanruo was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Xu Yanruo was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，崔遠罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Cui Yuan was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Cui Yuan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，刑部尚書裴贄為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Minister of Justice Pei Zan was made Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Minister of Justice Pei Zan was appointed Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，朱全忠陷瀛州。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Zhu Quanzhong captured Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zhu Quanzhong took Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，陷景州，執刺史劉仁霸。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day bingchen he captured Jingzhou and seized prefect Liu Renba.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on bingchen he took Jingzhou and seized prefect Liu Renba.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，陷莫州。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou he captured Mozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he took Mozhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，陷祁州，刺史楊約死之。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi he captured Qizhou; prefect Yang Yue died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he took Qizhou and prefect Yang Yue was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲申陷定州，義武軍節度使王郜奔於太原。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen he captured Dingzhou; Yiwu military commissioner Wang Gao fled to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he took Dingzhou and Yiwu military commissioner Wang Gao fled to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑，左右神策軍中尉劉季述、王仲先、內樞密使王彥范、薛齊偓作亂，皇帝居於少陽院。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jichou Left and Right Divine Strategy Army eunuch-commanders Liu Jishu, Wang Zhongxian, Inner Palace Commissioners Wang Yanfan and Xue Qiyu made disorder; the emperor dwelt in the Shaoyang Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jichou Left and Right Divine Strategy Army eunuch-commanders Liu Jishu and Wang Zhongxian and Inner Palace Commissioners Wang Yanfan and Xue Qiyu staged a coup; the emperor was confined to the Shaoyang Court.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，季述以皇太子裕為皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Jishu installed heir apparent Virtuous King Yu as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Jishu installed heir apparent Virtuous King Yu as emperor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 十二月，劉季述殺睦王倚。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Liu Jishu killed Prince of Mu Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Liu Jishu killed Prince of Mu Yi.

sentences.zh: 是歲，馬殷陷桂、宜、岩、柳、象五州。

translations.literal: That year Ma Yin captured Gui, Yi, Yan, Liu, and Xiang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ma Yin took Gui, Yi, Yan, Liu, and Xiang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 睦州刺史陳晟卒，其弟詢自稱刺史。

translations.literal: Muzhou prefect Chen Sheng died; his younger brother Xun styled himself prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Muzhou prefect Chen Sheng died and his younger brother Xun declared himself prefect.

sentences.zh: 天復元年

translations.literal: The first year of Tianfu.
translations.idiomatic: Tianfu, year 1.

sentences.zh: 天復元年正月乙酉，左神策軍將孫德昭、董彥弼、周承誨以兵討亂，皇帝復於位。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Tianfu on the day yiyou Left Divine Strategy army officers Sun Dezhao, Dong Yanbi, and Zhou Chenghui with troops suppressed the disorder; the emperor was restored to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Tianfu on yiyou Left Divine Strategy army officers Sun Dezhao, Dong Yanbi, and Zhou Chenghui suppressed the coup and restored the emperor.

sentences.zh: 劉季述、薛齊偓伏誅，降封皇太子裕為德王。

translations.literal: Liu Jishu and Xue Qiyu were executed; heir apparent Virtuous King Yu was demoted to Prince of De.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jishu and Xue Qiyu were executed and heir apparent Virtuous King Yu was demoted to Prince of De.

sentences.zh: 戊申，朱全忠陷絳州。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Zhu Quanzhong captured Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zhu Quanzhong took Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，崔胤為司空。

translations.literal: On the day renzi Cui Yin was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Cui Yin became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠陷晉州。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong captured Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong took Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，以旱避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiayin because of drought the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiayin drought led the emperor to withdraw from the main hall and reduce meals.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，朱全忠陷河中，執護國軍節度使王珂。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen Zhu Quanzhong captured Hezhong and seized Huguo military commissioner Wang Ke.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhu Quanzhong took Hezhong and seized Huguo military commissioner Wang Ke.

sentences.zh: 辛未，封全忠為梁王。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Quanzhong was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Quanzhong was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 是月，翰林學士、戶部侍郎王溥為中書侍郎，吏部侍郎裴樞為戶部侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: That month Hanlin Academician and Minister of Revenue Wang Pu was made Secretariat Vice Director, and Minister of Personnel Pei Shuai as Minister of Revenue: Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hanlin Academician and Minister of Revenue Wang Pu became Secretariat Vice Director and Minister of Personnel Pei Shuai Minister of Revenue, both appointed Associate Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，昭義軍節度使孟遷叛附于朱全忠。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day xinhai Zhaoyi military commissioner Meng Qian rebelled and submitted to Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinhai Zhaoyi military commissioner Meng Qian rebelled and submitted to Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 四月壬子，全忠陷沁、澤二州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day renzi Quanzhong captured Qin and Ze prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on renzi Quanzhong took Qin and Ze prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，儀州刺史張鄂叛附于全忠。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Yizhou prefect Zhang E rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yizhou prefect Zhang E rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 武德、貞觀配饗功臣主祭子孫敘進之，介公、酅公後予一子九品正員官。

translations.literal: Descendants of Wude and Zhenguan paired-sacrifice meritorious officials were advanced in rank; one son of the Duke of Jie and Duke of Xi was given a ninth-rank regular office.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of Wude and Zhenguan paired-sacrifice meritorious officials were advanced in rank; one son each of the Dukes of Jie and Xi received a ninth-rank regular office.

sentences.zh: 免光化以來畿內逋負。

translations.literal: Arrears in the capital region since Guanghua were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Capital-region arrears since Guanghua were remitted.

sentences.zh: 五月，李茂貞來朝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Li Maozhen came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Li Maozhen came to court.

sentences.zh: 六月，李克用陷隰、慈二州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Li Keyong captured Xi and Ci prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Li Keyong took Xi and Ci prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十月戊戌，朱全忠犯京師。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day wuxu Zhu Quanzhong attacked the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on wuxu Zhu Quanzhong attacked the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，陷同州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jiyou he captured Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiyou he took Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，如鳳翔。

translations.literal: On the day renzi the emperor went to Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the emperor went to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，朱全忠陷華州，鎮國軍節度使韓建叛附于全忠。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Zhu Quanzhong captured Huazhou; Zhenguo military commissioner Han Jian rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Zhu Quanzhong took Huazhou and Zhenguo military commissioner Han Jian rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，兵部侍郎盧光啟權句當中書事。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Minister of War Lu Guangqi provisionally handled Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Minister of War Lu Guangqi provisionally directed Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，李茂貞及朱全忠戰於武功，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Li Maozhen and Zhu Quanzhong fought at Wugong and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Li Maozhen fought Zhu Quanzhong at Wugong and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，盧光啟為右諫議大夫，參知機務。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Lu Guangqi was made Right Remonstrator and participated in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Lu Guangqi was made Right Remonstrator with participation in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，朱全忠犯鳳翔。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen Zhu Quanzhong attacked Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhu Quanzhong attacked Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，陷邠州，靜難軍節度使李繼徽叛附于全忠。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei he captured Binzhou; Jingnan military commissioner Li Jihui rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he took Binzhou and Jingnan military commissioner Li Jihui rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，崔胤、裴樞罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Cui Yin and Pei Shuai were removed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Cui Yin and Pei Shuai were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，鐘傳陷吉州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Zhong Chuan captured Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Zhong Chuan took Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，清海軍節度使徐彥若卒，行軍司馬劉隱自稱留後。

translations.literal: That year Qinghai military commissioner Xu Yanruo died; campaign deputy military commissioner Liu Yin styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qinghai military commissioner Xu Yanruo died and campaign deputy military commissioner Liu Yin declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 武貞軍節度使雷蒲卒，其子彥威自稱留後。

translations.literal: Wuzhen military commissioner Lei Pu died; his son Yanwei styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhen military commissioner Lei Pu died and his son Yanwei declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丁卯，給事中韋貽範為工部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year on the day dingmao Supervising Secretariat Drafter Wei Yifan was made Minister of Works and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year on dingmao Supervising Secretariat Drafter Wei Yifan was appointed Minister of Works and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙子，給事中嚴龜為汴、岐和協使。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Supervising Secretariat Drafter Yan Gui was made Bian-Qi peace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Supervising Secretariat Drafter Yan Gui was made Bian-Qi peace commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，盜發簡陵。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jihai Jianling was robbed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jihai Jianling was looted.

sentences.zh: 王建陷利州，昭武軍節度使李繼忠奔於鳳翔。

translations.literal: Wang Jian captured Lizhou; Zhaowu military commissioner Li Jizhong fled to Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian took Lizhou and Zhaowu military commissioner Li Jizhong fled to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，晝晦。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day gengxu daylight was dim.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on gengxu daylight turned dim.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，朱全忠陷汾州。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Zhu Quanzhong captured Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Zhu Quanzhong took Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，浙西大雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day yimao Zhexi had heavy rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhexi saw heavy rain and snow.

sentences.zh: 戊午，朱全忠陷慈、隰二州。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Zhu Quanzhong captured Ci and Xi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Zhu Quanzhong took Ci and Xi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，李克用陷汾、慈、隰三州。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Li Keyong captured Fen, Ci, and Xi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Keyong took Fen, Ci, and Xi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 四月，盧光啟罷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Lu Guangqi was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Lu Guangqi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，溫州刺史朱褒卒，其兄敖自稱刺史。

translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wenzhou prefect Zhu Bao died and his elder brother Ao declared himself prefect.

sentences.zh: 楊行密陷升州。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi captured Shengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi took Shengzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，李茂貞及朱全忠戰於武功，敗績。

translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingwu Li Maozhen fought Zhu Quanzhong at Wugong and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 庚午，韋貽範罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Wei Yifan was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Wei Yifan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，中書舍人蘇檢為工部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。
