translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingzi Secretariat Drafting Attendant Su Jian was appointed Minister of Works and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，朱全忠陷鳳州。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Zhu Quanzhong captured Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhu Quanzhong took Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月甲辰，陷成州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiachen he captured Chengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiachen he took Chengzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，陷隴州。

translations.literal: On the day yisi he captured Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he took Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，韋貽範起復。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jihai Wei Yifan was recalled to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jihai Wei Yifan returned to office.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，王建陷興元，山南西道節度使王萬弘叛附於建。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Wang Jian captured Xingyuan; Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Wang Wanhong rebelled and submitted to Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wang Jian took Xingyuan and Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Wang Wanhong rebelled and submitted to Jian.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，李茂貞及朱全忠戰于槐林，敗績。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day wushen Li Maozhen and Zhu Quanzhong fought at Huailin and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on wushen Li Maozhen fought Zhu Quanzhong at Huailin and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 武定軍節度使拓拔思恭叛附于王建。

translations.literal: Wuding military commissioner Tuoba Sichong rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: Wuding military commissioner Tuoba Sichong rebelled and submitted to Wang Jian.

sentences.zh: 十月癸酉，楊行密為東面諸道行營都統，及湖南節度使馬殷討朱全忠。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day guiyou Yang Xingmi was made eastern circuits campaign overall commander, and Hunan military commissioner Ma Yin was ordered to attack Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on guiyou Yang Xingmi was made eastern circuits campaign overall commander and Hunan military commissioner Ma Yin was ordered to attack Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 王建陷興州。

translations.literal: Wang Jian captured Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian took Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，保大軍節度使李茂勳以兵援鳳翔。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day guimao Baoda military commissioner Li Maoxun brought troops to aid Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on guimao Baoda military commissioner Li Maoxun marched to relieve Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，韋貽範薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Wei Yifan died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wei Yifan died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，溫州將丁章逐其刺史朱敖。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day guisi Wenzhou officer Ding Zhang expelled his prefect Zhu Ao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on guisi Wenzhou officer Ding Zhang expelled prefect Zhu Ao.

sentences.zh: 己亥，朱全忠陷鄜州，保大軍節度使李茂勳叛附于全忠。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Zhu Quanzhong captured Yanzhou; Baoda military commissioner Li Maoxun rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhu Quanzhong took Yanzhou and Baoda military commissioner Li Maoxun rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 是歲，盧光稠陷韶州。

translations.literal: That year Lu Guangchou captured Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year Lu Guangchou took Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 岳州刺史鄧進思卒，其弟進忠自稱刺史。

translations.literal: Yuezhou prefect Deng Jinsi died; his younger brother Jinzhong styled himself prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhou prefect Deng Jinsi died and his younger brother Jinzhong declared himself prefect.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丙午，平盧軍節度使王師範取兗州。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year on the day bingwu Pinglu military commissioner Wang Shifan captured Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year on bingwu Pinglu military commissioner Wang Shifan took Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，殺左右神策軍護軍中尉韓全誨張彥弘、內樞密使袁易簡周敬容。

translations.literal: On the day wushen the Left and Right Divine Strategy Army protector-commanders Han Quanhui, Zhang Yanhong, and Inner Palace Commissioners Yuan Yijian and Zhou Jingrong were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Left and Right Divine Strategy Army protector-commanders Han Quanhui and Zhang Yanhong and Inner Palace Commissioners Yuan Yijian and Zhou Jingrong were executed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，翰林學士姚洎為汴、岐和協使。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai Hanlin Academician Yao Ji was made Bian-Qi peace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Hanlin Academician Yao Ji was made Bian-Qi peace commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，工部尚書崔胤為司空，兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day renzi Minister of Works Cui Yin was made Minister of Works, concurrently Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Minister of Works Cui Yin became Minister of Works and concurrently Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸朱全忠軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the emperor visited Zhu Quanzhong's army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the emperor visited Zhu Quanzhong's camp.

sentences.zh: 己巳，至自鳳翔，哭於太廟，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day jisi he returned from Fengxiang, wept at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he returned from Fengxiang, mourned at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚午，崔胤及朱全忠殺中官七百餘人。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Cui Yin and Zhu Quanzhong killed more than seven hundred inner attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Cui Yin and Zhu Quanzhong executed more than seven hundred inner attendants.

sentences.zh: 辛未，胤判六軍十二衛事。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Yin directed the Six Armies and Twelve Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yin took charge of the Six Armies and Twelve Guards.

sentences.zh: 丁章伏誅。

translations.literal: Ding Zhang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Zhang was executed.

sentences.zh: 二月，雨土。

translations.literal: In the second month earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month earth fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，貶陸扆為沂王傅，分司東都。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Lu Yi was demoted to Prince of Yi Tutor and assigned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Lu Yi was demoted to Prince of Yi Tutor and assigned to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙子，王溥罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Wang Pu was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wang Pu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠殺蘇檢、吏部侍郎盧光啟。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong killed Su Jian and Minister of Personnel Lu Guangqi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong executed Su Jian and Minister of Personnel Lu Guangqi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，降京畿、河中鳳翔興德府、同邠鄜三州死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin capital-region, Hezhong, Fengxiang Xingde Prefecture, and Tong, Bin, and Yan prefectures had death sentences and below reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin death sentences and below were commuted in the capital region, Hezhong, Fengxiang Xingde Prefecture, and Tong, Bin, and Yan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己卯，輝王祚為諸道兵馬都元帥；

translations.literal: On the day jimao Prince of Hui Zuo was made overall commander of the circuits' armies;
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Prince of Hui Zuo was made overall commander of the circuits' armies;

sentences.zh: 庚辰，朱全忠為太尉、中書令副之。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen Zhu Quanzhong as Grand Preceptor and Secretariat Director was deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Zhu Quanzhong as Grand Preceptor and Secretariat Director served as deputy.

sentences.zh: 崔胤為司徒。

translations.literal: Cui Yin was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yin became Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 乙未，清海軍節度使裴樞為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei Qinghai military commissioner Pei Shuai was made Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Qinghai military commissioner Pei Shuai was appointed Secretariat Vice Director and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月，朱全忠陷青州。

translations.literal: In the third month Zhu Quanzhong captured Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhu Quanzhong took Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 楊行密陷密州，刺史劉康乂死之。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi captured Mizhou; prefect Liu Kangyi died.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi took Mizhou and prefect Liu Kangyi was killed.

sentences.zh: 酉月己卯，朱全忠判元帥府事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day jimao Zhu Quanzhong directed overall commander headquarters affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jimao Zhu Quanzhong directed overall commander headquarters affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，荊南節度使成汭及楊行密戰於君山，死之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day renzi Jingnan military commissioner Cheng Run and Yang Xingmi fought at Junshan; Run died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on renzi Jingnan military commissioner Cheng Run fought Yang Xingmi at Junshan and was killed.

sentences.zh: 武貞軍節度使雷彥威之弟彥恭陷江陵。

translations.literal: Wuzhen military commissioner Lei Yanwei's younger brother Yangong captured Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhen military commissioner Lei Yanwei's younger brother Yangong took Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，朱全忠陷登州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day yihai Zhu Quanzhong captured Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on yihai Zhu Quanzhong took Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，楊行密殺奉國軍節度使朱延壽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Yang Xingmi killed Fengguo military commissioner Zhu Yanshou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yang Xingmi killed Fengguo military commissioner Zhu Yanshou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，朱全忠陷棣州，刺史邵播死之；

translations.literal: On the day xinhai Zhu Quanzhong captured Dizhou; prefect Shao Bo died;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Zhu Quanzhong took Dizhou and prefect Shao Bo was killed;

sentences.zh: 陷密州。

translations.literal: He also captured Mizhou.
translations.idiomatic: he also took Mizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，平盧軍節度使王師範叛附于全忠。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Pinglu military commissioner Wang Shifan rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Pinglu military commissioner Wang Shifan rebelled and submitted to Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 十月，忠義軍將趙匡明陷江陵，自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Zhongyi army officer Zhao Kuangming captured Jiangling and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zhongyi army officer Zhao Kuangming took Jiangling and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 王建陷忠、萬、施三州。

translations.literal: Wang Jian captured Zhong, Wan, and Shi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian took Zhong, Wan, and Shi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，陷夔州。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu he captured Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he took Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，平盧軍將劉鄩以兗州叛附于朱全忠。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou Pinglu army officer Liu Zhen with Yanzhou rebelled and submitted to Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Pinglu army officer Liu Zhen surrendered Yanzhou to Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 十二月，裴贄罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Pei Zan was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Pei Zan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 楊行密陷宣州，寧國軍節度使田頵死之。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi captured Xuanzhou; Ningguo military commissioner Tian Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi took Xuanzhou and Ningguo military commissioner Tian Yun was killed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，禮部尚書獨孤損為兵部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Minister of Rites Dugu Sun was made Minister of War and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Minister of Rites Dugu Sun was appointed Minister of War and Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙申，朱全忠殺尚書左僕射致仕張浚。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Zhu Quanzhong killed retired Left Vice Minister of Works Zhang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhu Quanzhong killed retired Left Vice Minister of Works Zhang Jun.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年

translations.literal: The first year of Tianyou.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou, year 1.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年正月乙巳，崔胤罷。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Tianyou on the day yisi Cui Yin was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Tianyou on yisi Cui Yin was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 裴樞判左三軍事，獨孤損判右三軍事。

translations.literal: Pei Shuai directed the left three armies; Dugu Sun directed the right three armies.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Shuai directed the left three armies and Dugu Sun the right three armies.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書崔遠為中書侍郎，翰林學士、右拾遺柳璨為右諫議大夫：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Minister of War Cui Yuan was made Secretariat Vice Director, and Hanlin Academician and Right Reminder Liu Can as Right Remonstrator: Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Cui Yuan became Secretariat Vice Director and Hanlin Academician and Right Reminder Liu Can Right Remonstrator, both appointed Associate Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 己酉，朱全忠殺太子少傅崔胤及京兆尹鄭元規、威遠軍使陳班。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Zhu Quanzhong killed Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Cui Yin, Jingzhao governor Zheng Yuangui, Weiyuan army commissioner Chen Ban, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Zhu Quanzhong killed Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Cui Yin, Jingzhao governor Zheng Yuangui, Weiyuan army commissioner Chen Ban, and others.

sentences.zh: 戊午，全忠遷唐都於洛陽。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Quanzhong moved the Tang capital to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Quanzhong moved the Tang capital to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，日中見北斗。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day bingyin the Big Dipper was seen at midday.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on bingyin the Big Dipper was visible at midday.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，次陝州。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the emperor halted at Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the emperor stopped at Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠來朝。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong came to court.

sentences.zh: 甲申，封子禎為端王，祁豐王，福和王，禧登王，祐嘉王。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen his sons Zhen were enfeoffed as Prince of Duan, Qi as Prince of Feng, Fu as Prince of He, Xi as Prince of Deng, and You as Prince of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen his sons Zhen, Qi, Fu, Xi, and You were made Princes of Duan, Feng, He, Deng, and Jia.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，朱全忠兼判左右神策及六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day dingwei Zhu Quanzhong was additionally made director of the Left and Right Divine Strategy Armies and the Six Armies and Twelve Guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on dingwei Zhu Quanzhong was additionally placed in charge of the Left and Right Divine Strategy Armies and the Six Armies and Twelve Guards.

sentences.zh: 閏四月壬寅，次谷水。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month on the day renyin the emperor halted at Gushui.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month on renyin the emperor stopped at Gushui.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠來朝。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong came to court.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，至自西都。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the emperor returned from the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the emperor returned from the western capital.

sentences.zh: 享於太廟。

translations.literal: Sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 大風，雨土。

translations.literal: Great wind; earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: A great wind blew and earth fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day yisi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 六月，靜難軍節度使楊崇本會李克用、王建兵以討朱全忠。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Jingnan military commissioner Yang Chongben joined Li Keyong and Wang Jian's troops to attack Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Jingnan military commissioner Yang Chongben joined Li Keyong and Wang Jian to attack Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 七月乙丑，全忠以兵屯於河中。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day yichou Quanzhong encamped his troops at Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on yichou Quanzhong encamped his army at Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，全忠以左右龍武統軍朱友恭、氏叔琮、樞密使蔣玄暉兵犯宮門；

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day renyin Quanzhong with Left and Right Dragon Martial commanders Zhu Yougong, Shi Shuzong, and Army Supervisor Jiang Xuanhui's troops attacked the palace gates;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renyin Quanzhong with Left and Right Dragon Martial commanders Zhu Yougong and Shi Shuzong and Army Supervisor Jiang Xuanhui attacked the palace gates;

sentences.zh: 是夕，皇帝崩，年三十八。

translations.literal: That night the emperor died; he was thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: That night the emperor died at thirty-eight.

sentences.zh: 明年，起居郎蘇楷請更諡「恭靈莊閔」，廟號襄宗。

translations.literal: The next year Court Gentleman Su Kai requested changing the posthumous title to "Respectful, Spiritual, Solemn, and Mild" and the temple name to Emperor Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Court Gentleman Su Kai sought to change the posthumous title to Respectful, Spiritual, Solemn, and Mild and the temple name to Emperor Xiang.

sentences.zh: 至後唐同光初，復故號諡云。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tongguang in Later Tang the former title and posthumous name were restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tongguang in Later Tang the former title and posthumous name were restored.

sentences.zh: 昭宣光烈孝皇帝諱祝，昭宗第九子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhaoxuan the Bright and Fierce Filial, taboo name Zhu, was the ninth son of Zhaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhaoxuan the Bright and Fierce Filial, bore the taboo name Zhu, and was the ninth son of Zhaozong.

sentences.zh: 母曰皇太后何氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager He.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager He.

sentences.zh: 始封輝王。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Hui.
translations.idiomatic: He was first made Prince of Hui.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠已弑昭宗，矯詔立為皇太子，監軍國事。

translations.literal: After Zhu Quanzhong had murdered Zhaozong, by forged edict he was established as heir apparent to supervise state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhu Quanzhong murdered Zhaozong, a forged edict installed him as heir apparent to supervise state affairs.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年

translations.literal: The first year of Tianyou.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou, year 1.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，盧約陷溫州。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Lu Yue captured Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Lu Yue took Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 楊行密殺平盧軍節試使安仁義。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi killed Pinglu military commissioner An Renyi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi killed Pinglu military commissioner An Renyi.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，盜焚乾陵下宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou robbers burned the lower palace of Qianling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou robbers burned the lower palace of Qianling.

sentences.zh: 二月，楊行密陷鄂州，武昌軍節度使杜洪死之。

translations.literal: In the second month Yang Xingmi captured Ezhou; Wuchang military commissioner Du Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Yang Xingmi took Ezhou and Wuchang military commissioner Du Hong was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，朱全忠殺德王裕及棣王祤、虔王禊、遂王禕、景王秘、祁王祺、瓊王祥。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Zhu Quanzhong killed Virtuous King Yu and Princes of Di Qi, Qian Xi, Sui Yi, Jing Mi, Qi Qi, and Qiong Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhu Quanzhong killed Virtuous King Yu and Princes of Di Qi, Qian Xi, Sui Yi, Jing Mi, Qi Qi, and Qiong Xiang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬聖穆景文孝皇帝于和陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou the Sagely Solemn and Civil Filial Emperor was buried at Heling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Sagely Solemn and Civil Filial Emperor was interred at Heling.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，裴樞罷。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiazi Pei Shuai was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiazi Pei Shuai was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，獨孤損罷。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin Dugu Sun was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Dugu Sun was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎張文蔚同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Zhang Wenwei was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Zhang Wenwei was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲申，崔遠罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Cui Yuan was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Cui Yuan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎楊涉同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Yang She was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Yang She was appointed Associate Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月乙未，以旱避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day yiwei because of drought the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on yiwei drought led the emperor to withdraw from the main hall and reduce meals.

sentences.zh: 庚子，有彗星出於酉北；

translations.literal: On the day gengzi a comet appeared in the northwest;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi a comet appeared in the northwest;

sentences.zh: 甲辰，出於北河。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen it appeared in the Northern River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen it appeared in the Northern River.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，降京畿死罪以下，給復山陵役者一年。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai capital-region death sentences and below were reduced; those on mausoleum labor were granted one year's relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai capital-region death sentences and below were commuted and mausoleum laborers were granted one year's relief.

sentences.zh: 五月，王建陷金州，戎昭軍節度使馮行襲奔於均州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Wang Jian captured Jinzhou; Rongzhao military commissioner Feng Xingxi fled to Junzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wang Jian took Jinzhou and Rongzhao military commissioner Feng Xingxi fled to Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，行襲克金州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Xingxi recaptured Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Xingxi recaptured Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 楊行密陷婺州，執刺史沈夏。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi captured Wuzhou and seized prefect Shen Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi took Wuzhou and seized prefect Shen Xia.

sentences.zh: 戊子，朱全忠殺裴樞及靜海軍節度使獨孤損、左僕射崔遠、吏部尚書陸扆、工部尚書王溥、司空致仕裴贄、檢校司空兼太子太保致仕趙崇、兵部侍郎王贊。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Zhu Quanzhong killed Pei Shuai, Jinghai military commissioner Dugu Sun, Left Vice Minister of Works Cui Yuan, Minister of Works Lu Yi, Minister of Works Wang Pu, retired Minister of Works Pei Zan, Acting Minister of Works and Heir Apparent Grand Tutor Zhao Chong, and Minister of War Wang Zan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhu Quanzhong executed Pei Shuai, Jinghai military commissioner Dugu Sun, Left Vice Minister of Works Cui Yuan, Minister of Works Lu Yi, Minister of Works Wang Pu, retired Minister of Works Pei Zan, Acting Minister of Works and Heir Apparent Grand Tutor Zhao Chong, and Minister of War Wang Zan.

sentences.zh: 七月，卜郊。

translations.literal: In the seventh month suburban sacrifice was divined.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month suburban sacrifice was divined.

sentences.zh: 岳州刺史鄧進忠叛附于馬殷。

translations.literal: Yuezhou prefect Deng Jinzhong rebelled and submitted to Ma Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhou prefect Deng Jinzhong rebelled and submitted to Ma Yin.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，朱全忠陷襄州，忠義軍節度使趙匡凝奔於淮南。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day jiazi Zhu Quanzhong captured Xiangzhou; Zhongyi military commissioner Zhao Kuangning fled to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiazi Zhu Quanzhong took Xiangzhou and Zhongyi military commissioner Zhao Kuangning fled to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，封弟裕為潁王，祐蔡王。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin his younger brother Yu was enfeoffed as Prince of Ying and You as Prince of Cai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin his younger brother Yu was made Prince of Ying and You Prince of Cai.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠陷江陵，留後趙匡明奔于成都。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong captured Jiangling; acting commissioner Zhao Kuangming fled to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong took Jiangling and acting commissioner Zhao Kuangming fled to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改卜郊。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou suburban sacrifice was rescheduled.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou suburban sacrifice was rescheduled.

sentences.zh: 十月丙戌，朱全忠為諸道兵馬元帥。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day bingxu Zhu Quanzhong was made overall commander of the circuits' armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on bingxu Zhu Quanzhong was made overall commander of the circuits' armies.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，三卜郊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day gengwu suburban sacrifice was divined a third time.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengwu suburban sacrifice was divined a third time.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，淮南節度使楊行密卒，以其子渥為淮南節度副大使、東面諸道行營都統。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen Huainan military commissioner Yang Xingmi died; his son Wo was made Huainan deputy military commissioner and eastern circuits campaign overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Huainan military commissioner Yang Xingmi died and his son Wo was made Huainan deputy military commissioner and eastern circuits campaign overall commander.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，朱全忠為相國，總百揆，封魏王。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Zhu Quanzhong was made Chancellor, oversaw all affairs, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Zhu Quanzhong was made Chancellor, oversaw all affairs, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，全忠為天下兵馬元帥，殺蔣玄暉及豐德庫使應頊、尚食使朱建武。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day yiwei Quanzhong was made overall commander of the empire's armies; he killed Jiang Xuanhui, Fengde Storehouse commissioner Ying Qi, and Chief Provisioner Zhu Jianwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yiwei Quanzhong was made overall commander of the empire's armies and killed Jiang Xuanhui, Fengde Storehouse commissioner Ying Qi, and Chief Provisioner Zhu Jianwu.

sentences.zh: 癸卯柳璨為司空。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Liu Can was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Liu Can became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 戊申，朱全忠殺皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Zhu Quanzhong killed the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zhu Quanzhong killed the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，罷郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai suburban sacrifice was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai suburban sacrifice was canceled.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，貶柳璨為登州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Liu Can was demoted to Dengzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Can was demoted to prefect of Deng.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，殺璨及太常卿張廷範。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Can and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zhang Tingfan were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Can and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zhang Tingfan were executed.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬戌，淮南將王茂章以宣、歙二州叛附于錢升。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year on the day renxu Huainan officer Wang Maozhang with Xuan and She prefectures rebelled and submitted to Qian Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year on renxu Huainan officer Wang Maozhang surrendered Xuan and She prefectures to Qian Sheng.

sentences.zh: 二月，楊渥陷岳州。

translations.literal: In the second month Yang Wo captured Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Yang Wo took Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，王建陷歸州。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Wang Jian captured Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Wang Jian took Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 四月癸未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day guiwei the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month on guiwei there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 鎮南軍節度使鐘傳卒，其子匡時自稱留後。

translations.literal: Zhennan military commissioner Zhong Chuan died; his son Kuangshi styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhennan military commissioner Zhong Chuan died and his son Kuangshi declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月，錢升陷衢、睦二州，刺史陳璋、陳詢奔於淮南。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Qian Sheng captured Qu and Mu prefectures; prefects Chen Zhang and Chen Xun fled to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Qian Sheng took Qu and Mu prefectures and prefects Chen Zhang and Chen Xun fled to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 七月，楊渥陷饒州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Yang Wo captured Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Yang Wo took Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，朱全忠陷相州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day guiwei Zhu Quanzhong captured Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on guiwei Zhu Quanzhong took Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，楊渥陷洪州，執鐘匡時。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Yang Wo captured Hongzhou and seized Zhong Kuangshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yang Wo took Hongzhou and seized Zhong Kuangshi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，匡國軍節度使劉知俊陷坊州，執刺史劉彥暉。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Kuangguo military commissioner Liu Zhijun captured Fangzhou and seized prefect Liu Yanhui.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Kuangguo military commissioner Liu Zhijun took Fangzhou and seized prefect Liu Yanhui.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳，楊崇本會鳳翔、涇原、鄜延、秦隴兵以討朱全忠，戰于美原、敗績。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day xinsi Yang Chongben joined Fengxiang, Jingyuan, Yanyan, and Qin-Long troops to attack Zhu Quanzhong; they fought at Meiyuan and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinsi Yang Chongben joined Fengxiang, Jingyuan, Yanyan, and Qin-Long forces against Zhu Quanzhong, fought at Meiyuan, and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 十一月，忠國軍節度使高彥卒，其子澧自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Zhongguo military commissioner Gao Yan died; his son Li styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhongguo military commissioner Gao Yan died and his son Li declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月戊辰，李克用陷潞州，昭義軍節度使丁會叛附於克用。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month on the day wuchen Li Keyong captured Luzhou; Zhaoyi military commissioner Ding Hui rebelled and submitted to Keyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month on wuchen Li Keyong took Luzhou and Zhaoyi military commissioner Ding Hui rebelled and submitted to Keyong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，震電，雨雪。

translations.literal: On the day yihai thunder and lightning; rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai there was thunder and lightning with rain and snow.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，劉守光囚其父仁恭，自稱幽州盧龍軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year Liu Shouguang imprisoned his father Rengong and styled himself Youzhou Lulong army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year Liu Shouguang imprisoned his father Rengong and declared himself Youzhou Lulong military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月戊午，錢升陷溫州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day wuwu Qian Sheng captured Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on wuwu Qian Sheng took Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，皇帝遜于位，徙于曹州，號濟陰王。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the emperor abdicated, was moved to Caozhou, and styled Prince of Jiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the emperor abdicated, was moved to Caozhou, and styled Prince of Jiyin.

sentences.zh: 梁開平二年二月遇殺，年十七，諡曰哀帝。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Kaiping of Liang he was murdered; he was seventeen; his posthumous title was Emperor Ai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Liang Kaiping he was murdered at seventeen; his posthumous title was Emperor Ai.

sentences.zh: 後唐明宗追諡昭宣光烈孝皇帝，陵曰溫陵。

translations.literal: Later Tang Emperor Mingzong posthumously honored him Emperor Zhaoxuan the Bright and Fierce Filial; his tomb was called Wenling.
translations.idiomatic: Later Tang Emperor Mingzong posthumously honored him Emperor Zhaoxuan the Bright and Fierce Filial; his tomb was Wenling.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：自古亡國，未必皆愚庸暴虐之君也。

translations.literal: Eulogy: Since antiquity states have perished not necessarily under foolish, mediocre, or brutal rulers.
translations.idiomatic: Eulogy: Since antiquity states have fallen not only under foolish, mediocre, or brutal rulers.

sentences.zh: 其禍亂之來有漸積，及其大勢巳去，適丁斯時，故雖有智勇，有不能為者矣，可謂真不幸也，昭宗是已。

translations.literal: When calamity and disorder come they accumulate gradually; when the great momentum is already gone and one happens to meet that time, even with wisdom and courage one may be unable to act—this may be called true misfortune; such was Zhaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Calamity and disorder accumulate gradually; when the great momentum is already spent and one meets that moment, even wisdom and courage may avail nothing—true misfortune, as with Zhaozong.

sentences.zh: 昭宗為人明雋，初亦有志於興復，而外患已成，內無賢佐，頗亦慨然思得非常之材，而用匪其人，徒以益亂。

translations.literal: Zhaozong was by nature bright and keen; at first he also had the will to restore the dynasty, but external threats had already formed and within there were no worthy assistants; he too sighed and sought extraordinary talent, yet employed unfit men and only increased disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozong was bright and keen and at first wished to restore the dynasty, but external threats had already formed, worthy aides were lacking within, and though he sought extraordinary talent he appointed unfit men and only deepened disorder.

sentences.zh: 自唐之亡也，其遺毒餘酷，更五代五十餘年，至於天下分裂，大壞極亂而後止。

translations.literal: From the fall of Tang its lingering poison and residual cruelty continued through more than fifty years of the Five Dynasties until the realm split apart and great ruin and extreme disorder ceased only afterward.
translations.idiomatic: From Tang's fall its lingering poison and cruelty persisted through more than fifty years of the Five Dynasties until the realm split and extreme disorder ran its course.

sentences.zh: 跡其禍亂，其漸積豈一朝一夕哉！

translations.literal: Tracing its calamity and disorder, was its gradual accumulation accomplished in a single morning or evening?
translations.idiomatic: Tracing that calamity and disorder—was its gradual accumulation the work of a single morning or evening?
